questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple turns or curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you there is limited overhead space coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the side shown by the arrow because a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn drivers of work zones or unusual conditions ahead. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance is happening on the road. Slow down and drive carefully through the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only continue when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to avoid brake damage or collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of mechanical turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will make a sharp turn to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that drivers in this lane can either turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must travel on a one-way street. It shows traffic flows in only one direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When a driver's left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the driver plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. This sign means right turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws you must obey. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign tells you a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.
